descriptions.text: Summoning Trap. This is a Recycled Trap. Effect: Once triggered, will summon two town guards or minions to the location of the trap. Will summon two random guards or minions from this floor only. If you do not have minions or if you do not control a town, this trap will misfire. Specific guards or minions may be programmed at a Sapper's Table. Delay: two seconds. Target: Programmable. Duration: one time use.

recap.text: Carl watches lights pop up across the muddy slope above Fort Freedom, where bush elves crawl through alarms and summoning traps to carve a path to the water. His foot hits an undisarmed summoning trap, and two dead naiad guards splat on the hill and roll at him; he hurdles one. While Samantha makes her own way to the shore, he trips two by accident, brings Find Traps to ten, and collects ten summoning traps.

beats.headline: Lights on the slope
beats.text: From the edge of the forest above Fort Freedom, a long, muddy slope runs down to the river, cleared of foliage by the naiads so they can see anything coming. As Carl watches, lights pop up all over it. Traps, lots of them: alarms and summoning traps, and silent alarms all along the stone walkway. A group of bush elves crawls over the mud, quietly disarming the ones inside the protection spell, then creeps out of it to start on one Carl had not even noticed. They are carving a path to the water.
beats.gist: Carl watches bush elves disarm lit traps on the muddy slope, carving a path to the river.

beats.headline: Two dead guards
beats.text: Knocked off course by a sizzling saddle, Carl scrambles back up the hill toward the rampaging boss, and his foot hits a summoning trap nobody disarmed. A pair of naiad guards suddenly appear in front of him, already dead, splat onto the hill and roll down toward him. He has to hurdle one to keep going.
beats.gist: Carl hits an undisarmed summoning trap, and two dead naiad guards splat onto the hill; he hurdles one.

beats.headline: Ten for the inventory
beats.text: While Samantha makes her own way to the shore, Carl works the slope for untriggered traps to train his stalled Find Traps skill. The summoning traps are hard to spot. He trips two by accident, and both times they bring a pair of naiad guards, every one of them already killed by were-castors. After the third or fourth, Find Traps reaches ten, and the slope lights up like a Christmas display. He collects everything, ten summoning traps among it. He has no towns on this floor and no minions; that is a Donut thing. If they ever use one, she will have to set it.
beats.gist: Carl trips two summoning traps while training Find Traps to ten, then collects ten of them.
